scheme_name: Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a native of Rajasthan.
Must have passed 8th class from a Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls' School in Rajasthan.
Must have passed 10th class with at least 50% marks in a government school and be enrolled in 11th class in a government school.
Must have passed 12th class with at least 50% marks in a government school and be enrolled in the first year of a recognized undergraduate course.
benefits_summary: STDR of ₹2,000 for girls in Class 11 (5‑year term) and ₹4,000 for girls entering graduation (3‑year term).
